_note: Wave 50, lane B8 — the measurement that settled BACKLOG queue 6(c) "Android box-shadow ~2.4x over-blur (MultipleShadowApplier.kt)". Device Gaussian sigma fitted from the COMMITTED baselines (no device), against css-backgrounds-3 6.1.2: blur radius r means a Gaussian with sigma = r/2 (Blink skia_utils BlurRadiusToStdDev). RESULT: Android is at sigma parity — on the best-conditioned pair (024_Shadow_Colored, blur 15, target 7.50) Android fits 7.494 against web 7.092 and iOS 7.067; on the inset pair (107, blur 20, target 10.0) Android 9.688 / web 8.498 / iOS 8.274. No platform is 2.4x wide, and Android is never the widest by more than 14% of web. The over-blur (raw CSS radius straight into BlurMaskFilter) existed ONLY in effects/shadow/MultipleShadowApplier.kt, which had ZERO call sites since the initial import (954b38e8) and is listed in the retro's own dead-code census (tools/titan/results/retro-2026-09-04/p2a-compose-dead-remaining.json); the LIVE path has converted through ShadowApplier.blurMaskRadius since wave 2 (0b2313a8, 2026-07-17) — verified present at 07f75ec9, the very commit whose probe produced the 2.4x reach number. The file is deleted in this wave and the parity is pinned by runtimes/compose/src/test/java/com/styleconverter/runtime/effects/shadow/ShadowBlurSigmaParityTest.kt. WHAT A LATER WAVE MUST ACT ON: (1) the docs/STATUS.md 'Android over-blurs box-shadow by ~2.4x' row states a file attribution that is wrong and a magnitude this measurement does not reproduce — it should be struck with this artifact as the evidence; (2) the reach excess the 2026-08-28 probe measured (Android 123/131/131/120 bottom-most shadow row vs web 93/101/109/90, box rows 30-70, blur 10, offset-y 10, spread -8/0/+8/-1px; probe fixture not committed, so it cannot be re-run here) is NOT a blur-sigma error. The two mechanisms that DO widen an Android shadow's painted extent were both repaired after that probe and are still corpus-unmeasured: the retro's R6 border-box knockout + opacity attenuation and round-2 F1's margin-box stripping (ShadowGeometry.borderBoxRect / outsetShadowRect). The wave-50 device gate re-measures them; re-probe the reach there before re-opening 6(c).

023_Shadow_Simple.caveat: the 5px/5px offset parks most of the field under the opaque box; the visible sliver leaves sigma and amplitude correlated

107_Edge_InsetRoundShadow.caveat: corner squares masked (radius 20px); the fill is read from the capture, so a platform that paints the fill differently shifts the amplitude, not sigma
